edgeCases.title: Twin rail
edgeCases.summary: Two ordinary cables choose the same deterministic mid-channel.
edgeCases.expected: The shared vertical separates into two 14-unit channels.

edgeCases.title: Offset triple
edgeCases.summary: Three staggered sources and sinks overlap through most of one corridor.
edgeCases.expected: All three channels separate without a crossing.

edgeCases.title: Tight four
edgeCases.summary: Four close port rows make the shared run dominate the drawing.
edgeCases.expected: Stable cable identity resolves otherwise free ordering.

edgeCases.title: Wide five
edgeCases.summary: A five-cable bundle spans a larger vertical range.
edgeCases.expected: Every avoidable coincident interior run reaches zero.

edgeCases.title: One-to-five fan-out
edgeCases.summary: Five routes leave one source point before diverging to separate sinks.
edgeCases.expected: The shared source trunk stays; the interior channels fan out cleanly.

edgeCases.title: Five-to-one fan-in
edgeCases.summary: Five sources converge on one sink while sharing the middle corridor.
edgeCases.expected: The shared sink trunk stays; upstream channels remain legible.

edgeCases.title: Inverted pair
edgeCases.summary: Source order and sink order disagree, so one crossing is topologically real.
edgeCases.expected: Overlap disappears and exactly one unavoidable crossing is reported.

edgeCases.title: Seven-port bus
edgeCases.summary: Seven aligned port rows compress into a single automatic rail.
edgeCases.expected: Seven deterministic rails appear in source order.

edgeCases.title: Short overlaps
edgeCases.summary: Five verticals touch the same rail only over short staggered spans.
edgeCases.expected: Even short overlaps above tolerance receive separate channels.

edgeCases.title: Long overlaps
edgeCases.summary: Six cables cross a tall gap with nearly complete coincident runs.
edgeCases.expected: The large overlap collapses to distinct 14-unit rails.

edgeCases.title: Horizontal shared track
edgeCases.summary: Four orthogonal routes collide along a horizontal interior segment.
edgeCases.expected: Axis-independent nudging separates the horizontal track vertically.

edgeCases.title: Two-axis grid
edgeCases.summary: A vertical bundle and a horizontal bundle occupy the same scene.
edgeCases.expected: Each axis is solved independently; transverse crossings stay explicit.

edgeCases.title: Two independent buses
edgeCases.summary: Two remote block pairs each carry their own overlapping bundle.
edgeCases.expected: Both components tidy in one command without influencing each other.

edgeCases.title: Locked centre rail
edgeCases.summary: The middle cable is hand-routed and therefore immovable.
edgeCases.expected: Free cables spread around the retained authored channel.

edgeCases.title: Two authored constraints
edgeCases.summary: Two of seven coincident cables already carry user-authored geometry.
edgeCases.expected: Both authored rails stay byte-identical; five free rails move around them.

edgeCases.title: Obstacle, three shared runs
edgeCases.summary: A wall forces six-point routes sharing two verticals and one horizontal.
edgeCases.expected: All three channel bundles separate with zero avoidable overlap.

edgeCases.title: Obstacle, five cables
edgeCases.summary: Five six-point cables snake around the same large obstacle.
edgeCases.expected: Each shared run gets its own independently ordered channel set.

edgeCases.title: Coincident subpath
edgeCases.summary: Six routes share consecutive interior segments before their true fork.
edgeCases.expected: Stable identity breaks the depth-1 tie; no oscillation appears.

edgeCases.title: Authored cable around an obstacle
edgeCases.summary: A five-route obstacle bundle contains an authored middle path.
edgeCases.expected: Three shared runs tidy while the authored path remains fixed.

edgeCases.title: Sixteen-cable stress board
edgeCases.summary: Three dense buses, two axes, an obstacle, and retained authored routes.
edgeCases.expected: Every eligible shared channel is processed deterministically in one pass.
